top_apps.description_excerpt:
Ice Pull is a reaction and timing game that puts you in the middle of an intense ice fishing challenge. A fish is hooked beneath the ice, but pulling it out is not as easy as it seems. You must carefully control the tension of the fishing line to avoid losing your catch.

Hold your finger on the screen to pull the fish upward. As the tension meter rises, watch it closely. When the gauge reaches the red zone, release immediately to prevent the line from snapping. Once the meter returns to the green zone, start pulling again.

Every fish fights back with sudden jerks, making each catch unpredictable. Releasing too often allows the fish to swim deeper, while holding for too long breaks the line. As you progress, the safe green zone becomes smaller, demanding even greater precision.

Your goal is to pull the fish out of the ice hole before the timer expires. Break the line or let the fish escape too deep, and the round is over.

top_apps.description_excerpt:
Can your group become a global power? Rebuild, defeat rivals, and expand your territory together.
The invasion left your territory in ruins. Rebuilding it is the first step towards recovery, but glory requires more - trusted allies.

Connect with real players worldwide and fight rivals in wars to expand your nation. Work together to conquer territories and climb the leaderboards.


MAIN FEATURES:
Rebuild: use your resources to rebuild regions and become stronger;
Join a Group: cooperate, chat, and fight together for glory;
Real-time War: participate in real-time battles with your Group against players from all over the world;
Group Chat: talk to your mates and coordinate your attacks;
Different outcomes: attack rival players to dominate them, defend against raids, help your group & friends with gifts;

Rival Nations is free to play, but some items can be purchased for real money.

A network connection is required to play! For now, a Facebook account is also necessary in order to play.

For any issues or suggestions regarding the game, contact us at: support@greenhorsegames.com

"## Gameplay

- **Objective**: In each level, you must successfully guide the laser beam emitted by the Emitter to the target Receiver and reflect it through a series of mirrors.
- **Controls**:
- **Rotate Mirror**: Click and drag a mirror to rotate it 360 degrees, changing the angle of the laser's reflection.
- **Move Mirror**: In some levels, the mirror can be dragged to different positions.
- **Challenge Elements**:
- **Obstacles**: The laser cannot penetrate these obstacles, so you must navigate around them.
- **Time Limit**: Each level has a countdown, and you must complete it within the allotted time. The remaining time counts towards your score.
